title: StewardMD Oncology Protocol Template (reusable regimen)
description: A reusable chemotherapy protocol template. NOT patient-specific. A Patient Treatment Plan snapshots this whole object verbatim (version lock by snapshot). Doses are decision-support: every computed value is clinician-confirmed and no value is auto-ordered. Citations are by name only, no page numbers, original synthesis.
comment: additionalProperties:true because a template carries an additive display layer (premedications, supportiveCare, monitoring, doseModificationRules NOTES). The invariant core below is enforced.

diseaseId.description: Back-pointer to the KB disease id this regimen treats (e.g. dlbcl).

lifecycleState.description: Only 'active' templates may be selected for new treatment plans.

caps.description: Where dose caps come from. There is NO universal hidden cap; caps are read from drug/protocol data.

textbook.description: Licensed textbook title, name only, no page numbers.

institution.description: Provenance chain: reference regimen -> institutional review -> approved variant. 'approval' null for reference regimens.

doseModificationRules.description: NOTES ONLY in v1: rendered verbatim in the dose/clearance drawer, never parsed or auto-applied. The engine flags, the clinician decides.

basis.description: bsa=per m2 (Mosteller); auc=Calvert; mgkg=per kg; flat=absolute.

caps.description: perDose (absolute cap, e.g. vincristine 2 mg) and/or cumulativeLifetime (e.g. doxorubicin). Absent = no cap.
